caption: The drawing is a pencil sketch on a yellowed, aged piece of paper. At the center of the composition is an object resembling an ornate oil lamp or decorative stand. The object consists of a round glass or metal upper chamber with two angled cylindrical protrusions at the top, which may represent handles or spouts. Below the chamber, there is a decorative band that appears to be adorned with leaf-like or floral motifs. The central stem is elongated and tapers downward, leading to a wide, circular base that provides stability. In the lower left corner, there is a small, rectangular inset sketch illustrating a close-up of the decorative band’s motif, featuring leaves and berries arranged within an oval frame. In the lower right corner, another small inset depicts a simplified, scaled version of the main object, annotated with vertical and horizontal measurements indicating its proportions (10” tall by 4 3/8” wide). The artist’s name, “Irving D. Gerin,” is lightly inscribed beneath the main sketch. There are two pieces of yellowed tape or adhesive residue on the left side of the paper. The entire composition is done in grayscale, with pencil shading used to indicate volume and detail. The word “leads” is written in cursive on the left margin.
title: Lamp
